overview.en:
Explore incident response and on-call workflows using Rootly’s official Code Mode MCP connection.

Review incident and response context with its timeline and service ownership. Use recorded facts to prepare handoffs or a post-incident review.

Complete the connection or local-runtime setup described by this plugin before using service tools. Results depend on the tools exposed to your account; specify the target resource and report scope when starting a task.
overview.zh-CN:
通过 Rootly 官方 Code Mode MCP 连接查询事故响应信息并处理值班工作流程。

结合时间线与服务负责人查看事故和响应上下文，依据已记录事实准备交接或事后复盘。

使用服务工具前，按插件说明完成连接或本地运行环境配置。结果取决于账号可用工具；开始任务时请说明目标资源与报告范围。

starterPrompts.en: Summarize this incident's current status and response timeline.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 汇总这起事故的当前状态与响应时间线。

starterPrompts.en: Review the available on-call and response information for this service.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 查看这个服务的可用值班与响应信息。

starterPrompts.en: Prepare a handoff brief with unresolved issues and next actions.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 准备交接简报，列出未解决问题与后续行动。
